5612-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5612-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4279-4616-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4616-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2921-5170-6132-8175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

1349-3899-6863--133.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
There is a coin counter on Blue.
1349-3899-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

883-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1477-2111-4981.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

64-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
64-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-4927-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-4927-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-4927-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

1368-2033-6321-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-6321-7175.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-5508--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

3236-4276.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
3236-4276.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four untapped Wizards.
3236-4276.description:
Activate number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Sigil Tracer by paying {1}{U} and tapping two Wizards you control, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all lands you control.
Holding priority, activate number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Sigil Tracer by paying {1}{U} and tapping two Wizards you control, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the Turnabout copy, untapping all creatures you control.
3236-4276.notes: The combo can perform if your lands and creatures not used to copy Turnabout can produce {2}{U}{U}. This can reduce the amount of mana needed from lands, or provide additional infinite mana. If you have infinite {U}, you can choose not to untap lands and choose to untap artifacts instead.

3259-4742-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

643-5310-6797-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5310-6797-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2366-3430-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-5089-5226-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1734-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-5231-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4067-4182-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Clues.
4067-4182-5527.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

5060-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5060-5078-6650.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
5060-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1429-2018-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

277-343-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-343-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
You are the monarch.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-343-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-2527-3143-3464.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2438-2527-3143-3464.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1494-4499-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has power five or greater.
1494-4499-4802.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2457-4231-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token as well as a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate two of the artifact tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

457-1409-2564-4231.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
457-1409-2564-4231.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two artifacts, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability to cast all cards in your library.

844-1789-2232-2972.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, Ganax and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Ganax.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

186-1700-4385-4587.description:
All slivers have haste.
Tap a Sliver to generate {1}.
Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.
